accdbInventory.reason: No provenance or benchmark report was supplied; the ACCDB is a Windows/ACE-only binary source.

accdbMemberHashRecord.arbitration: The issue byte count matches the archive member exactly; the issue member SHA-256 does not match any byte sequence in the pinned archive, so the measured hash governs and the declared hash is recorded as superseded.
accdbMemberHashRecord.reproduction: curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reallaksh19/Common/f4d49f2a47d970ae0abf913b537193e324556177/LFEA/BM4/BM4_L.zip | sha256sum; then unzip -p BM4_L.zip BM4_L.ACCDB | sha256sum

commonCommitDeclarations.reconciliation: Both commits publish the same BM4_L.zip SHA-256, so the archive identity is unambiguous even though the commits differ.

intakeOrder: Pin the code commit and record a clean worktree.

Run the frozen non-friction controls before accepting any friction result.
Run primitive friction cases L13, L7, then L1, then the derived L15 combination.
